fixture: Disposable database; real local routes and development sign-in; stubbed model; no external network. Does not verify Google OAuth or external integrations.
checks: Original/replacement entries, all certainty labels and their symbols stay visible; type values and the earlier-version filter retain their original behavior while the legend starts closed.
Changes over time retains each version and reason; source links open the exact referenced record. Missing work records are labelled as absent, without inventing human authorship.
Independent history failure retains labelled prior data and source content; a valid empty timeline has its own read-only recovery, which returns to the real recorded history.
A real browser visits A, B and A again while the first A source reply is held; that obsolete response cannot overwrite the current entry when released.
Memory header actions remain within the panel at 390/768/1280px; inspected mobile and desktop images preserve readable source and history sections.
A member sees the real server privacy placeholder for a linked restricted source; private content is never supplied to the simplified view.
Earlier-version content and provenance exceed 4.5:1 contrast in both themes; the retained original keeps its certainty, earlier-version label and struck-through content.

screenshots.description: Memory uses a collapsed certainty explanation, a clear type filter and Include earlier versions. Every entry still shows certainty, author, source and correction warnings.
Changes over time opens the original corrected entry without hiding its original certainty; links, review date, correction warning and source remain readable.
A failed history refresh keeps the selected source and last-known changes visible, with its own recovery. Empty history is never inferred from the failed request.
A complete empty timeline gets an explicit message and Refresh history while the selected memory entry remains available.
Plain-English history, source and dependent-entry sections keep complete provenance and certainty, with the same exact source navigation.
Earlier versions stay readable in dark mode: the original content remains struck through and clearly labelled, while text and authorship exceed 4.5:1 contrast.
